about.title: What this page is
about.body: This page follows your app as Pam builds it. It updates by itself, so you can leave it open.
about.p1: The big card shows where you are and what comes next.
about.p2: "Your turn" means something is ready for you to open and look at.
about.p3: Buttons open your design, your demo or your live app in a new tab.
about.p4: This page only shows progress. To change anything or move on, talk to Pam in your chat.

idea.title: Talking through your idea
idea.body: Tell Pam what the app is for and who will use it. Nothing gets made until you're ready.

ready.title: Ready for the next step
ready.body: Tell Pam when you'd like to go on. Nothing gets made until you say so.

dbuild.title: Designing your screens
dbuild.body: Laying out every screen of your app on one page. Pam will let you know when it's ready.

dready.title: Your screens are ready
dready.body: Have a look. Tell Pam what to change, or say when you'd like a demo you can click through.

dredo.title: Your screens need an update
dredo.body: Your idea changed, so the screens don't match it anymore. Ask Pam to update them when you're ready.

mbuild.title: Building your demo
mbuild.body: A version you can click through. It looks like the real thing, but nothing is saved yet.

mready.title: Your demo is ready
mready.body: Click through it. Tell Pam what to change, or say when you'd like the real app built.

mredo.title: Your demo needs an update
mredo.body: You changed the screens, so the demo doesn't match them anymore. Ask Pam to rebuild it when you're ready.

lbuild.title: Building your app
lbuild.body: Putting your app online with real data and sign-in. Pam will let you know when it's ready.

lredo.title: Your app needs an update
lredo.body: Something changed since your app went online, so it doesn't match anymore. Ask Pam to update it when you're ready.

live.title: Your app is live
live.body: It's online at its own address, with real data and sign-in. Give it a try.

access.title: Checking who can see what
access.body: Deciding who can see and change each part of your app.

pay.title: Payments, if you need them
pay.body: If your app takes payments, Pam helps you set them up. If not, this step is skipped.

name.title: Picking a nicer name
name.body: Choose a shorter address and the picture people see when your link is shared.

cost.title: Seeing what it costs to run
cost.body: A plain look at what your app costs to keep running.

done.title: Everything's set
done.body: Your app is live and launched. Come back to Pam any time for changes or new features.

next.name: Pick a nicer name
next.cost: See what it costs to run

notRunning: not running, ask Pam to reopen it

down.design: Your design isn't running right now. Ask Pam to reopen it.
down.demo: Your demo isn't running right now. Ask Pam to reopen it.

afterLive.title: Your app is built
afterLive.body: Ask Pam for changes or new features any time, and your app updates in place. This page doesn't track those changes. It keeps following the last few setup steps below.
afterLive.setBody: Ask Pam for changes or new features any time, and your app updates in place. This page doesn't track those changes, so you can close it now.

footer: To change anything or move on, talk to Pam in your chat
